source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"A classification generally considered to carry fairly little established relationship to a client's actual functional status","B":"An absence of any limitation in physical activity, contrary to what this particular classification actually indicates","C":"Marked limitation of physical activity, with symptoms occurring with less-than-ordinary activity, though comfortable at rest","D":"Symptoms present even while the client is at rest, a description more consistent with Class IV than Class III"}}
source_row.rationale: NYHA Class III indicates marked limitation of physical activity, with symptoms (such as fatigue or dyspnea) occurring with less-than-ordinary activity, though the client remains comfortable at rest, distinct from Class IV (symptoms at rest) or milder classes.
source_row.source_name: New York Heart Association Functional Classification
